mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_product (shop_id, platform_product_id, platform_sku_id, listing_status, last_sync_at) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{platformProductId}, #{platformSkuId}, #{listingStatus}, #{lastSyncAt}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE platform_sku_id = COALESCE(new.platform_sku_id, shop_product.platform_sku_id), listing_status = new.listing_status, last_sync_at = new.last_sync_at
